title: CIA sends Mooney's Cherokee book and asks about Native American DNA

tellings.quote: a book showed up to my house that uh was sent from some folks in the government CIA and said, "Read this."

plain: A book arrived at his home in North Carolina, sent by people from the CIA with a note saying "Read this," and they asked him about Native American DNA. Chris Bledsoe, a man known for reporting repeated UFO encounters, tells Jesse Michels this happened to him. The book was Myths of the Cherokee, published in 1891 by James Mooney, a collection of the tribe's old stories, which suggests the agency thought his experiences linked to those traditions.
